title: Outpatient Physical Therapy Evaluation and Treatment
source: Plan Medical Policy (synthetic, modeled on MCG-style outpatient rehab guidelines)

required_documentation.description: A referring diagnosis and ordering provider for the physical therapy episode of care.
Documentation of a functional limitation the therapy is intended to address.

criteria: A qualified provider has referred the patient for physical therapy evaluation and/or treatment.
The clinical notes describe a functional limitation (pain, weakness, reduced range of motion, or difficulty with activities of daily living) related to the diagnosis.
No more than 3 initial evaluation visits and standard treatment frequency are being requested (higher frequency/duration requests route to standard review).
No red flags requiring urgent escalation (e.g., acute neurological deficit, suspected fracture) are present.
notes: Synthetic policy created for this demo; not an actual InterQual/MCG criterion.
